name: lkrequest
description: Node.js HTTP client with byte-level TLS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 fingerprint control, powered by Rust
author: BurstLinker Inc.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path crates/lkrequest-napi/Cargo.toml --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.cts --features quic-h3,telemetry,synthetic-fp,doh,masque
scripts.build:native:debug: napi build --platform --manifest-path crates/lkrequest-napi/Cargo.toml --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.cts --features quic-h3,telemetry,synthetic-fp,doh,masque
scripts.lint: biome check . && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
